referenceSources.title: New From SVRA: A Place to Race Old Miatas | News | Classic Motorsports
referenceSources.description:
Three classic Mazda Miatas battle wheel to wheel on a racetrack, each fitted with roll cages, sponsor decals, and racing numbers. The lead white Miata bears a bright green KKRPRODUCTS.COM windshield banner, while the green Miata alongside displays miatacage.com. A dark gray Miata trails closely behind, all three demonstrating the close-quarters excitement of spec Miata competition.

Introduced by SVRA in 2017, the Mazda Miata Heritage Cup features 1.6‑liter Miatas from 1990–1993, offering an affordable entry point for vintage racing enthusiasts. Rounds at venues like Auto Club Speedway, Road America, and Virginia International Raceway highlight the series’ appeal to both seasoned and younger drivers seeking reliable, race-ready classics.
